candidate_history.preservation_rule: The public candidate file remains unchanged and is retained as historical provenance.

source_split_correction.reason: The candidate designation recorded a preliminary source split. The final GSE288020 protocol derives the source split by a frozen SHA-256 ordering within immune-age strata.
source_split_correction.split_rule: Within each GSE288020 MGUS immune-age stratum, order donors by SHA-256 of 'GSE288020-MGUS-SPLIT-v1|<age>|<donor>' with donor-ID tie breaking; assign the first four young and first three old donors to calibration and the remainder to pilot; hold all nine MM donors for the internal test.
source_split_correction.superseded_final_refit_rule: refit each fixed estimator on all 23 GSE288020 subjects
source_split_correction.corrected_final_refit_rule: Select every configuration using only the salted 7/7 MGUS calibration/pilot split, then refit the fixed primary and every comparator on the 14 MGUS development donors only. The nine MM internal-test outcomes never enter the GSE309593 source model.
source_split_correction.branch_release_rule: GSE309593 may proceed after the GSE288020 development artifact and 14-MGUS source model are publicly closed, whether the separate MGUS-to-MM promotion diagnostic passes or fails, provided all five methods are valid and external_study_ready is true. Both studies' outcomes remain reportable.
source_split_correction.effect: This correction changes GSE288020 source development roles, final-refit membership, and branch release. It does not change the GSE309593 cohort, marker candidates, or estimand. The separate preaccess batch-inference amendment below supersedes the candidate designation's inference.

identifier_boundary_clarification.superseded_phrase: choose 512 common-identifier candidates by the frozen hash rule
identifier_boundary_clarification.operational_rule: The RNA-only stage selects exactly 512 H5 identifiers by the frozen salted-hash rule without opening an ADT file. The later ADT-only stage must find every selected identifier exactly once. Missing or duplicate selected identifiers cause terminal refusal; no replacement identifier or resampling is allowed.
identifier_boundary_clarification.reason: Whether an identifier is common to RNA and ADT cannot be known inside an RNA-only process. The operational rule is stricter and preserves the staged outcome firewall.

batch_inference_amendment.primary_interval: resample eligible subjects with replacement separately within each of the seven fixed batches, preserve each batch's observed subject count, and compute the donor-equal mean difference
batch_inference_amendment.leave_one_batch_jackknife_t_role: reported sensitivity only with 6 degrees of freedom
additional_primary_checks: one-sided exact sign-flip p-value at most 0.025 over the seven batch mean differences
negative donor-equal mean difference after leaving out each batch in turn
batch_inference_amendment.classical_interval: the same within-batch stratified paired-donor bootstrap used for the primary comparisons
batch_inference_amendment.reason: The 23 recipient subjects are nested in seven processing batches; batch-aware inference prevents subject-level pseudo-replication while retaining the donor-equal endpoint.

complete_supersession_matrix.superseding_rule: use the final salted age-stratified 7/7 MGUS split recorded above
refit on the 14 MGUS development donors only; never use the nine MM outcomes

complete_supersession_matrix.candidate_field: source branch after the GSE288020 internal diagnostic
complete_supersession_matrix.superseding_rule: the branch is independent of diagnostic direction but requires all 14 MGUS donors, all five valid methods, and external_study_ready
select 512 RNA identifiers first; the ADT stage must recover all 512 exactly once without replacement
use the within-batch stratified paired-donor bootstrap as primary; retain batch-block, unstratified donor, and jackknife-t intervals as sensitivities
apply source-matched RNA-only QC before salted selection: at least 200 detected genes, mitochondrial fraction at most 0.10, and at most 70000 RNA UMIs

mark a subject-marker unsupported when more than 128 cells lie in its raw-count tie block crossing the 256/256 boundary; serialize a 512/0 sentinel margin and exclude all pairs using that ADT for that subject, while preserving the global marker axis and applying the frozen informative-pair, subject-count, and seven-batch gates
bind exact runtime, canonical annotated tags, attempts, prerequisites, semantic payloads, hashes, and statuses at every stage

limit any positive interpretation to composition-inclusive cross-condition transfer among source-QC-matched selected cell mixtures; do not claim cell-type-conditional invariance or same-population causal transport

claim_scope_clarification: Any positive result is composition-inclusive cross-condition transfer among source-QC-matched selected cell mixtures, not cell-type-conditional invariance or same-population causal transport.

sequential_candidate_search_disclosure.claim_scope: GSE309593 is a separately frozen follow-on candidate; no campaign-wide confirmatory error-control claim is made.
